functions.name: goto_level
functions.sourceReview: Read the complete do.c goto_level() range (1479-2002). The supported ordinary-level transition preserves saved-level teardown, destination generation, arrival placement, vision and redraw order, deferred feedback, and the new-level message branches. Added the source-ordered Rogue/primary assign_graphics() selection before u.uz changes, check_gold_symbol(), and the Rogue arrival line from do.c:1912-1914. The supporting symbols.c assign_graphics() and botl.c check_gold_symbol() implementations preserve selected tables, overrides, currentgraphics, and the printable coin-symbol boundary; no result-valued unported callee is used by this span.

callers.source: allmain.c deferred_goto() dispatches the scheduled transition to do.c goto_level() after the command stack unwinds
teleport.c level_tele() accepts a wizard numeric destination and schedules goto_level()
artifact.c invoke_portal() calls goto_level() for a cross-dungeon portal transition

entryPointReview: The selected source range has one exercised production entry point: the wizard debug Ctrl-V level-teleport command enters teleport.c level_tele(), schedules a new ordinary or Rogue destination, allmain.c deferred_goto() dispatches do.c goto_level(), and goto_level() generates and displays the destination. The fresh recipe reaches the Rogue destination and its graphics/message branches through that production path.

entryPoints.name: wizard level teleport into a newly generated Rogue level
